messages:
Ravi Singh: Heads-up — Marlin Dynamics(renewal ~5 weeks) just went from ~15k tokens/day to almost 0 overnight. Saw a support ticket: "security review paused SSO". Flagging for renewal triage.
Priya Nair: Thanks Ravi. Do we know if the champion is still engaged? Last week PM had good feedback in QBR.
Sam Ortiz: Champion (CTO) was promoted; new security lead took over this week. Security asked to revoke external API keys until SAML assertions match their IdP rules. They also mentioned a "procurement pilot" with NimbusAI.
Claire Wu: I pulled recent activity: their seats show logins but no inference calls. Likely config/auth change. Quick check query I ran:
```sql
SELECT event, count FROM auth_events WHERE org = 'marlin' AND event LIKE '%saml%' AND ts >= '2026-03-15';
```
Claire Wu: Also uploaded the support ticket (SR-9087) notes to the shared folder.
Ravi Singh: Good catch. Proposed play: 1) Ask for a short joint call with Marlin security + infra to unblock SSO, 2) Offer a temporary private token with IP-restrictions so they can continue tests while IdP rules settle, 3) Fast TCO slide vs Nimbus to procurement. Thoughts? :+1:
Priya Nair: Agree. Add enablement: send a 3-step SAML checklist for their IdP. Keep outreach <=150 words. We should avoid sounding salesy.
Sam Ortiz: I can draft the checklist and a <150-word outreach note. ETA 2 hours. Also we should surface the contract cushion: renewal auto-renews but procurement can pause billing if they file hold. I'll ping legal if they request a pilot amendment.
Claire Wu: Also a minor perf ask: their devs reported model load time spikes during their last integration test. Could be infra cold start. I'll attach a quick warmup snippet they can add to their startup hook:
```bash
# warmup endpoint
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/engines/run -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"prompt":"warmup","max_tokens":1}'
```
Ravi Singh: Nice. Priya, can you lead the outreach? We should push the IP-limited token + checklist, and propose a 30-min unblock call. If they don't re-enable usage within 7 days after the call escalate to AE for exec outreach.
Priya Nair: On it. Draft outreach (short):
"Hi Sam (Marlin security),
Quick note from Priya at Redwood  we noticed your SSO change paused API calls. We can provide an IP-restricted token and a 3-step SAML checklist to unblock tests. Can we book a 20-min call this week to walk the security team through the steps?
Thanks,
Priya"
Sam Ortiz: That reads well. Add a sentence offering a tenant-level perf tune if warmup doesn't help.
Priya Nair: Added. Sending in 10.
ops-bot: SR-9087 linked to renewal task RD-778. Priority set to HIGH by Priya Nair.
Claire Wu: Uploaded Nimbus pilot notes and procurement requests they shared during demo. Lean pricing + 60-day trial ask.
Ravi Singh: We'll have Jordan (SE) on the call for perf/integration. Sam please prep the TCO one-pager and procurement comparison; keep it internal.
Sam Ortiz: Will do. I've started a doc: /shared/marlin/renewal-triage/compare-nimbus.md
Priya Nair: Outreach sent. I'll update thread after call. Closing interim actions here.
